body.name: \(F(\rho),\operatorname{Comp}(\rho)\)
body.construction: For a live prefix \(\rho=(\varnothing=A_0\to A_1\to\cdots\to A_k=A)\), where \(A_s=A_{s-1}\cup\{r_s\}\), define \(F(\rho)\) by placing \(\beta(A_{s-1},r_s)\) in original row slot \(r_s\) for \(s=1,\ldots,k\) and leaving other slots unassigned; define \(\operatorname{Comp}(\rho)=\{T_\pi:\pi\text{ is a source-to-sink path of }\mathcal D_G^{\mathrm{live}}\text{ extending }\rho\}\).
